input.command: adb devices -l && echo "----" && adb -s 4ae24c72 shell dumpsys activity activities | rg -n "mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity|Hist |realActivity|mCurrentFocus|WebView|payment\.heals|http" | head -80
input.description: Find resumed activity and web URLs

input.command: PID=$(adb -s 4ae24c72 shell pidof com.healshealthcare.healspass | tr -d '\r') && echo "PID=$PID" && echo "---- sockets ----" && adb -s 4ae24c72 shell "cat /proc/net/unix" | rg -i "webview|devtools|chrome" | head -40 && echo "---- log urls ----" && adb -s 4ae24c72 logcat -d -t 400 --pid="$PID" | rg -i "http|url|WebView|payment|navigate" | tail -60
input.description: Get WebView sockets and recent URLs

content.text: WebView 连的是 `api.yedpay.com`。我通过调试端口把当前页面地址取出来。

[print(p.get("type"), "|", p.get("title"), "\n", p.get("url"), "\n") for p in pages]'
